recognize_zh: 中倍下淋巴結結構瀰漫消失，背景以小淋巴球和淡粉紅細胞質的組織球為主，其間散在核大、空泡狀並有清楚核仁的大細胞，不成片，符合 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture without follicles in this field
Scattered isolated large cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and perinuclear clearing
Predominant background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large cells are evenly dispersed and do not form clusters or sheets
No nodular pattern or prominent sclerosis
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate composed mainly of small lymphocytes and histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Scattered throughout are isolated large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, without formation of sheets. No residual follicles or nodular pattern are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry is required to confirm CD20+ large B cells within a CD3+ T-cell and CD68+ histiocyte background and to exclude Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (diffuse THRLBCL-like pattern)
ddx.vs: NLPHL shows at least focal nodules with CD21+ FDC meshworks and small B cells, which are absent in THRLBCL.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD45-, typically with eosinophils and plasma cells in the background.
DLBCL NOS shows sheets of large cells rather than sparse large cells in a T-cell/histiocyte-rich background.
Lennert lymphoma has numerous epithelioid histiocytes but the atypical cells are small-to-medium CD3+ T cells.
